jobs.title: Director of Worldwide Marketing Data Strategy and Analytics
jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD100769

26WD100769 Director of Worldwide Marketing Data Strategy and Analytics

L'affichage de poste en français suivra / The French job posting follows

Position Overview

As the Director of Worldwide Marketing Data Strategy & Analytics, you will lead the strategy, measurement frameworks, data foundations, and analytical capabilities that enable Autodesk to understand and optimize Enterprise marketing’s impact on customer and business outcomes. You will lead a global team of data strategists and analysts responsible for transforming complex data into actionable insights, predictive intelligence, and decision-support capabilities across the enterprise marketing funnel and broader go-to-market ecosystem.

This role reports to the Senior Director of Worldwide Marketing Business Insights & Analytics and plays a critical role in advancing Autodesk’s journey toward audience-centric customer experiences and data-driven commercial decision-making. You will partner closely with Marketing and Go-to-Market leadership and across analytics and technology domains, including Sales, Data Science, Data Engineering, and Marketing Technology.

Responsibilities

Lead Marketing Data & Analytics Strategy: Own the end-to-end strategy, execution, and adoption of marketing analytics, measurement frameworks, and intelligence capabilities, partnering with Marketing leadership to translate business priorities into scalable analytical solutions for Enterprise Marketing
Lead a Global Analytics Team: Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing global team of data strategists and analysts, providing strategic direction, hands-on guidance, and opportunities for talent growth
Drive Business Performance Intelligence: Monitor and analyze business performance to identify emerging trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable levers for Marketing, including early indicators of pipeline performance and opportunities to improve business outcomes
Define Marketing Measurement & Attribution Strategy: Partner with Sales and Marketing leaders to establish measurement principles, KPIs, conversion definitions, attribution methodologies and windows, incrementality approaches, and other frameworks for evaluating marketing effectiveness and connecting marketing investment to customer and commercial outcomes
Drive Marketing Effectiveness & Investment Optimization: Integrate attribution, incrementality, experimentation, marketing mix modeling, and predictive analytics to identify performance drivers and inform resource allocation across audiences, channels, campaigns, and programs
Establish Analytics-Ready Data Foundations: Define the business and analytical requirements for foundational marketing data structures, including data models, taxonomies, event structures, identity resolution, campaign hierarchies, and governance required to reliably connect marketing activity with customer and business outcomes
Advance AI-Powered Analytics & Decisioning: Partner across Data Engineering, Data Science, Enterprise AI/ML, Marketing Technology, and Marketing to build scalable, governed capabilities that enable AI agents to generate insights, identify opportunities, recommend and optimize decisions, and orchestrate marketing actions with appropriate human oversight
Drive Adoption & Executive Decision Support: Translate complex analytical findings into clear business implications and recommendations, enabling leaders to understand what happened, why it happened, what is likely to happen next, and what actions should be taken

Minimum Qualifications

To be successful in this role, you have:

10+ years of professional experience with significant domain expertise in B2B marketing, sales, go-to-market, or customer analytics
5+ years of people leadership experience managing and developing technical and analytical talent, preferably across global or distributed teams
Demonstrated experience developing and operationalizing marketing measurement strategies, including attribution, incrementality, experimentation, marketing mix modeling, funnel measurement, and marketing effectiveness
Strong understanding of modern marketing and customer data foundations, including data models, customer and contact identity, campaign and event taxonomies, cloud data platforms, and business intelligence environments
Experience applying predictive analytics, data science, and AI/ML-enabled capabilities to business and marketing problems, with an understanding of the data, governance, and measurement foundations required to support AI-powered analytics and decisioning
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business questions into analytical frameworks, measurement approaches, data requirements, and actionable recommendations
Proven ability to communicate with and influence senior non-technical stakeholders while establishing strong partnerships with Data Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, Marketing Technology, and other technical teams
Demonstrated experience partnering across Marketing, Sales, Sales Operations, Customer Success, and other Go-to-Market functions to drive measurable business outcomes
Strong executive communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear strategic implications, recommendations, and decisions
Ability to lead multiple strategic priorities in a fast-paced, highly cross-functional environment while maintaining high standards for analytical rigor, quality, and business impact
BA/BS in Marketing, Business, Economics, Statistics, Data Science, or another quantitative or relevant field; advanced degree preferred but not required

_________________________________________________________________________

26WD100769 Directeur de la stratégie et de l’analyse des données marketing mondiales

Aperçu du Poste

En tant que directeur de la stratégie et de l’analyse des données marketing mondiales, vous dirigerez la stratégie, les cadres de mesure, les bases de données et les capacités analytiques qui permettent à Autodesk de comprendre et d’optimiser l’impact du marketing d’entreprise sur les résultats clients et commerciaux. Vous dirigerez une équipe mondiale de stratèges et d’analystes de données chargés de transformer des données complexes en informations exploitables, en intelligence prédictive et en capacités d’aide à la décision à travers l’entonnoir de marketing d’entreprise et l’écosystème de mise en marché au sens large.

Ce poste relève du directeur principal des analyses et des perspectives d’affaires du marketing mondial et joue un rôle essentiel dans la progression d’Autodesk vers des expériences client centrées sur l’auditoire et une prise de décision commerciale fondée sur les données. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les dirigeants du marketing et de la mise en marché, ainsi qu’avec les équipes des domaines de l’analyse et de la technologie, notamment les ventes, la science des données, l’ingénierie des données et la technologie marketing.

Responsabilités

Diriger la stratégie en matière de données et d’analyse marketing : Assumer la responsabilité de la stratégie de bout en bout, de la mise en œuvre et de l’adoption des analyses marketing, des cadres de mesure et des capacités d’intelligence, en collaboration avec la direction du marketing afin de traduire les priorités d’affaires en solutions analytiques évolutives pour le marketing d’entreprise
Diriger une équipe mondiale d’analyse : Recruter, former et diriger une équipe mondiale hautement performante composée de stratèges et d’analystes de données, en fournissant une orientation stratégique, des conseils pratiques et des occasions de développement des talents
Favoriser l’intelligence de la performance d’affaires : Surveiller et analyser la performance d’affaires afin d’identifier les tendances émergentes, les risques, les occasions et les leviers exploitables pour le marketing, y compris les indicateurs précoces de la performance du pipeline et les occasions d’améliorer les résultats d’affaires
Définir la stratégie de mesure et d’attribution marketing : Travailler en partenariat avec les dirigeants des ventes et du marketing pour établir des principes de mesure, des indicateurs de performance clés (IPK), des définitions de conversion, des méthodologies et des fenêtres d’attribution, des approches d’incrémentalité, ainsi que d’autres cadres permettant d’évaluer l’efficacité du marketing et de relier les investissements marketing aux résultats commerciaux et auprès des clients
Optimiser l’efficacité du marketing et les investissements : Intégrer l’attribution, l’incrémentalité, l’expérimentation, la modélisation du mix marketing et l’analyse prédictive afin d’identifier les facteurs de performance et d’orienter l’allocation des ressources entre les audiences, les canaux, les campagnes et les programmes
Établir des fondations de données prêtes pour l’analyse : Définir les exigences opérationnelles et analytiques relatives aux structures de données marketing fondamentales, y compris les modèles de données, les taxonomies, les structures d’événements, la résolution d’identité, les hiérarchies de campagnes et la gouvernance nécessaire pour relier de manière fiable les activités marketing aux résultats clients et d’affaires
Faire progresser l’analyse et la prise de décision alimentées par l’IA : Collaborer avec les équipes d’ingénierie des données, de science des données, d’IA/ML d’entreprise, de technologie marketing et de marketing afin de mettre en place des capacités évolutives et régies permettant aux agents d’IA de générer des informations, d’identifier des occasions, de recommander et d’optimiser les décisions, ainsi que d’orchestrer les actions marketing sous une supervision humaine appropriée
Favoriser l’adoption et soutenir la prise de décision de la haute direction : Traduire des résultats analytiques complexes en implications commerciales claires et en recommandations, permettant ainsi aux dirigeants de comprendre ce qui s’est passé, pourquoi cela s’est produit, ce qui est susceptible de se produire ensuite et quelles mesures devraient être prises

Qualifications Minimales

Pour réussir dans ce poste, vous devez posséder :

Plus de 10 ans d’expérience professionnelle avec une expertise approfondie dans les domaines du marketing B2B, des ventes, de la mise en marché ou de l’analyse de la clientèle
Plus de 5 ans d’expérience en leadership, notamment dans la gestion et le développement de talents techniques et analytiques, de préférence au sein d’équipes internationales ou dispersées
Une expérience avérée dans l’élaboration et la mise en œuvre de stratégies de mesure marketing, notamment l’attribution, l’incrémentalité, l’expérimentation, la modélisation du mix marketing, la mesure de l’entonnoir de conversion et l’efficacité marketing
Une solide compréhension des fondements du marketing moderne et des données clients, y compris les modèles de données, l’identité des clients et des contacts, les taxonomies de campagnes et d’événements, les plateformes de données en nuage et les environnements d’intelligence d’affaires
Une expérience dans l’application de l’analyse prédictive, de la science des données et des capacités basées sur l’IA et l’apprentissage automatique (IA/ML) à des problèmes d’affaires et de marketing, avec une compréhension des fondements en matière de données, de gouvernance et de mesure nécessaires pour soutenir l’analyse et la prise de décision alimentées par l’IA
Capacité avérée à traduire des questions d’affaires ambiguës en cadres analytiques, en approches de mesure, en exigences en matière de données et en recommandations concrètes
Capacité avérée à communiquer avec des intervenants de haut niveau non spécialisés dans le domaine technique et à les influencer, tout en établissant des partenariats solides avec les équipes d’ingénierie des données, de science des données, d’IA/ML, de technologie marketing et d’autres équipes techniques
Expérience avérée de l

jobs.title: Management Consulting Principal Director - Defence & Public Service - Industry & Enterprise
jobs.description:
We Are

Accenture's Defence & Public Service practice helps government, defence, and public safety organizations reinvent how they operate, modernize mission and enterprise capabilities, and deliver better outcomes for Canadians.

We combine deep industry expertise, AI-powered reinvention, technology innovation, and transformation leadership to help clients navigate complexity, improve readiness, and build the digital foundations required for the future.

You Are

You are a trusted advisor and transformation leader with experience in Defence, Public Service, National Security, or other complex public sector environments.

You combine executive relationship skills, business development experience, and delivery leadership to help clients solve critical challenges. You are comfortable engaging senior executives, shaping opportunities, leading teams, and translating strategy into measurable outcomes.

The Work

As a Principal Director, you will play a leadership role in growing Accenture's Defence & Public Service business while helping clients modernize operations, improve mission outcomes, and accelerate transformation. You will:

Build trusted relationships with senior government, defence, and industry leaders.

Identify, shape, and lead strategic transformation opportunities.

Lead pursuits, proposals, and solution development activities.

Advise clients on operating model, workforce, digital, AI, and mission modernization initiatives.

Lead complex transformation programs from strategy through implementation.

Bring together cross-functional teams to deliver integrated, outcome-focused solutions.

Develop market insights and thought leadership on emerging defence and public sector priorities.

Coach and develop consulting talent while contributing to practice growth and innovation.

Here's What You'll Need

10+ years of experience in consulting, Defence, Public Service, National Security, or related sectors.

Experience leading large-scale transformation programs and executive stakeholder relationships.

Proven business development and pursuit leadership experience.

Strong communication, facilitation, and executive presentation skills.

Experience managing multidisciplinary teams and complex stakeholder environments.

Eligibility to obtain or hold a Government of Canada security clearance.

A minimum of a high school diploma or GED is required for this position

Bonus Points If

Experience working with DND, CAF, Public Safety, RCMP, CBSA, SSC, PSPC, or other federal organizations.

Experience in mission systems, command and control, defence modernization, supply chain, logistics, enterprise transformation, or AI-enabled operations.

Existing Secret or Top Secret security clearance.

Experience working with defence industry partners, OEMs, or sovereign capability initiatives.

Why Accenture

Join a team helping shape the future of Defence and Public Service transformation. You'll work alongside industry leaders, advanced technologies, and global experts to solve some of Canada's most complex and important challenges while building a career at the forefront of reinvention.

jobs.title: Head of Strategic Finance
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Strategic Finance based in Canada.

We are looking for a strategic and commercially minded finance leader to drive financial planning, business performance, and long-term growth within a fast-growing, globally distributed organization. Reporting directly to the CFO and working closely with the CEO, you will take ownership of financial forecasting and ensure that forward-looking projections are closely aligned with actual business performance. You will oversee the development of sophisticated financial models, evaluate product and channel profitability, and translate complex financial data into actionable business insights. In addition, you will play a key role in investor relations, board reporting, and fundraising preparation. This position combines hands-on financial expertise with strategic business partnership, offering the opportunity to influence high-level decisions and contribute to an ambitious international mission. You will thrive in a collaborative, fully remote environment that values ownership, curiosity, innovation, and independent thinking.

Accountabilities

Take ownership of the company's financial growth plan and manage its execution cadence in collaboration with team leads, monitoring progress, evaluating performance, and identifying potential deviations early.
Build, maintain, and continuously improve a comprehensive bottom-up financial model that connects operational business drivers with financial forecasts and supports strategic decision-making.
Develop and monitor unit economics across products and acquisition channels, including customer lifetime value (LTV) and customer acquisition cost (CAC), to assess profitability and optimize growth investments.
Produce accurate forward-looking financial projections and ensure consistency between forecasts, actual financial results, and reported historical figures.
Lead the preparation and delivery of investor reporting, board updates, and fundraising materials, ensuring financial information is accurate, insightful, and clearly communicated.
Partner closely with the CEO and CFO to develop compelling financial narratives, support strategic planning, and provide recommendations on key business decisions.
Collaborate with product, insurance, and operational teams to understand business models, identify relevant performance indicators, and develop metrics that address critical business questions.
Identify financial risks, growth opportunities, and areas for operational improvement, translating complex analyses into practical recommendations.
Manage multiple financial workstreams independently, ensuring timely delivery, analytical accuracy, and effective coordination across departments.

Requirements

Strong financial and analytical background, ideally developed through investment banking, top-tier strategy consulting, or an equivalent highly analytical professional environment.
Previous experience in a strategic finance or financial planning role within a startup, preferably at Series A or Series B stage.
Exceptional financial modeling skills, with the ability to build structured, transparent, scalable models that other stakeholders can understand, audit, and extend.
Strong understanding of financial planning, forecasting, business performance analysis, and unit economics, including LTV and CAC.
A quantitative academic or professional background, such as computer science, mathematics, economics, finance, or a related discipline.
Excellent project management skills, with the ability to coordinate several initiatives simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and consistently meet deadlines.
Strong business judgment and strategic thinking, including the ability to identify the most important questions, determine the appropriate level of analytical precision, and proactively flag risks.
High level of ownership and initiative, with the ability to anticipate business needs and take action without requiring constant direction.
Strong intellectual curiosity and willingness to understand complex products, operational processes, and unfamiliar business areas.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate financial insights into clear recommendations for both financial and non-financial teams.
A collaborative and adaptable mindset, combined with integrity, creativity, independent thinking, and a willingness to experiment, learn, and challenge conventional approaches.
Genuine motivation to contribute to a mission-driven organization focused on improving global access to social protection and financial security.

Benefits

Fully remote working environment: Work from anywhere in the world, with a globally distributed team.
Transparent compensation: Clear and transparent compensation structure, including equity participation.
Global health and travel coverage: Access to an international safety net providing worldwide health, income, and travel protection.
Generous annual leave: A minimum of four weeks of vacation per year.
Personal development budget: Annual allowance to support professional growth, learning, and development.
Home office allowance: Dedicated budget to help create a comfortable and productive remote working environment.
Modern equipment: A new laptop provided for your work.
International team gatherings: Several team meetups each year in inspiring destinations around the world, offering opportunities to connect and collaborate in person.
Meaningful impact: Opportunity to contribute to an ambitious mission focused on making social protection and equal opportunities more accessible worldwide.
Professional autonomy: A high-ownership environment that encourages independent thinking, experimentation, and meaningful contributions to business strategy.

How Jobgether Works

to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. jobs.title: VP Portfolio Operations, 2 Hour Learning (Remote) - $200,000/year USD
jobs.description:
You’ve built dashboards. Tracked milestones. Chased vendors. Flagged risks. But your reports hit a ceiling. You weren’t the one making the calls.

2 Hour Learning is building an AI-powered education model designed to help students achieve a full day of academic progress in just two hours. Making that model work at scale requires dozens of initiatives, technology partners, contracts, and investment decisions to move in sync. Your job is to make the execution layer trustworthy enough for executives to act on it.

jobs.title: Director, Global Marketing & Sales Enablement
jobs.description:
Job Description

Title:
Director, Global Marketing & Sales Enablement

Id:
21681

Type:
FullTime

Location:
Bolton, ON

Husky TechnologiesTM a company with a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships, a strong sense of community and a unique culture and values. We are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM Canadian manufacturing facilities and global headquarters are located in Bolton, Ontario on a large, beautiful campus located just 20 minutes north of Toronto’s Pearson International Airport. Features include a fitness and wellness center, intramural sports activities, on-site cafeteria, and clean, state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities with outstanding safety records. We offer a great work environment and competitive total compensation package, including above market retirement savings plan and market competitive group benefits.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Director / GM, Global Marketing & Sales Enablement
is responsible for defining and driving Husky's global brand strategy, leading B2B marketing and demand generation, advancing sustainability advocacy and industry engagement, delivering actionable market intelligence, and improving global sales effectiveness.

Reporting to the EVP, Sales & Marketing, this leader will strengthen Husky's market position and industry influence, build an integrated commercial support function, and connect market insights, customer engagement, and sales capabilities to deliver measurable business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Global Brand Strategy, Marketing & Industry Advocacy
Own Husky's global brand strategy, positioning, identity, and differentiation, ensuring a compelling and consistent presence across markets and customer touchpoints.
Develop and execute global B2B marketing programs that generate qualified leads and commercial opportunities through digital channels, integrated campaigns, account-based marketing, trade shows, and customer events.
Lead Husky's sustainability advocacy and industry engagement strategy, partnering with industry associations, customers, and value-chain stakeholders to advance science-based understanding of plastics, address misconceptions, and promote responsible use, recycling, and circularity.
Represent Husky's perspectives in relevant industry initiatives and advocacy programs, strengthening its reputation as a credible technology leader and constructive voice in sustainability discussions.
Establish metrics to evaluate brand strength, marketing contribution to pipeline, and the reach and effectiveness of advocacy initiatives.
Market Intelligence & Strategic Insights
Lead a centralized market intelligence and research capability serving Sales, Product Line Management, Strategy, Investor Relations, and executive leadership.
Deliver actionable insights on market trends, competitive dynamics, customer needs, sustainability-related market developments, and emerging growth opportunities.
Support strategic planning, market prioritization, product portfolio decisions, and commercial growth initiatives.
Establish systematic approaches to market research, competitive intelligence, and voice-of-customer analysis.
Strategic Customer Engagement & Sales Enablement
Lead the development of executive-level content and strategic narratives for Top-to-Top (T2T) customer meetings, supporting senior leadership and strategic account engagement.
Develop high-impact sales enablement content, including value propositions, product and solution presentations, competitive positioning, case studies, and customer value tools.
Partner with Sales, Product Line Management, and Engineering to ensure differentiated, consistent, and customer-focused messaging.
Equip global commercial teams with the content, knowledge, and capabilities required to engage customers effectively and win business.
Sales Effectiveness & Commercial Excellence
Partner with Sales leadership to improve sales productivity, commercial processes, opportunity management, and overall sales effectiveness.
Drive adoption of sales methodologies, CRM capabilities, digital tools, and AI-enabled solutions to strengthen commercial execution.
Develop scalable approaches to sales training, onboarding, best-practice sharing, and continuous improvement of capability.
Establish performance metrics and improvement initiatives focused on sales efficiency, conversion rates, win rates, and commercial productivity.

Leadership & Experience

The successful candidate will be a strategic, commercially oriented leader with proven experience in global brand management, complex industrial B2B marketing, market intelligence, and sales enablement.

Experience engaging industry associations, building external partnerships, and shaping industry narratives around sustainability, circularity, or related topics is highly desirable.

The role requires strong business acumen, the ability to lead global multidisciplinary teams, and the credibility to influence executive stakeholders while translating market insights and brand strategy into measurable commercial outcomes.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or other advanced business degree considered an asset
10+ years of progressive leadership experience in global B2B marketing, brand strategy, commercial excellence, or sales enablement within a complex industrial, manufacturing, technology, or capital equipment environment
Demonstrated success developing and executing integrated marketing strategies that drive brand growth, lead generation, customer engagement, and measurable commercial results across global markets.
Proven experience leveraging market intelligence, competitive insights, and voice-of-customer research to influence business strategy, portfolio decisions, and growth initiatives.
Strong track record leading cross-functional and global teams, influencing executive stakeholders, and driving adoption of sales methodologies, CRM platforms, digital tools, and AI-enabled solutions to improve sales effectiveness.

Vacancy: Replacement

Pay Range: $150,000.00 - 185,000.00

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky Technologies TM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks.

Husky TechnologiesTM is committed to developing inclusive, barrier-free selection processes and work environments. If contacted in relation to a job opportunity or testing, you should advise the member of the Talent Acquisition team in a timely fashion of any disabilities that requires accommodation measures in order to enable you to be assessed in a fair and equitable manner.

Information received relating to accommodation measures will be addressed confidentially.

No agency or telephone inquiries please.
